opus.problem: This clue is about a different person: Levi son of Alphaeus, the tax collector. The other six clues are about Jacob's son and his tribe. The rules say a shared name needs clues that make clear which one is meant, but this set mixes two different people. It also fits Matthew (see Matthew 9:9), and the accepted answers (Levite, tribe of Levi) don't fit this clue. Replace it with a fact about the patriarch or the tribe, such as the Levites rallying to Moses after the golden calf (Exodus 32:26-28).
